(Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with the additional adhesive layer.

(Currently amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section includes a honeycomb structure.

(Currently amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening.

(Currently amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
